summary: The note describes London broil, a beef dish made by broiling marinated beef and then slicing it thinly across the grain. It points out that, despite the name, the dish and its terminology are North American rather than British.
one_line: London broil is a North American beef dish of marinated, broiled beef sliced thinly across the grain.
key_facts: London broil is a beef dish made by broiling marinated beef.
London broil is cut across the grain into thin strips after broiling.
Despite its name, London broil is not British.
The dish and the terminology of London broil are North American.

entities.name: London broil
entities.role: beef dish made by broiling marinated beef and cutting it into thin strips across the grain
